phase: External FX / Refinancing — Official Source Boundary Screening
purpose: Test whether newly identified official BNR, ECB, IMF and Ministry of Finance evidence jointly identifies a sector-compatible currency-denomination and residual-maturity/refinancing schedule. The screening must not combine marginal source dimensions into a synthetic joint exposure matrix.

ecb_bps.finding: Romania gross external debt is available quarterly by institutional sector and original maturity.
ecb_bps.boundary: Currency denominator remains All currencies (_T); original maturity is not residual maturity.

bnr_bop.finding: BNR annual balance-of-payments/IIP reports publish aggregate external-debt currency composition and debt-service/maturity information. Historical reports contain explicit currency tables; the 2023 annual report continues to present external-debt structures.
bnr_bop.boundary: Published aggregate currency composition does not identify the joint sector × currency distribution and may not be allocated to S13, banks and other sectors.

mof_s13_portfolio.source: Romania Investor Presentation, March 2025 / Government Debt Management Strategy
mof_s13_portfolio.boundary: These are government debt portfolio risk margins. They do not identify the principal due by currency block, matched coupon/refixing schedule, old/new refinancing rates or private-sector exposures.

imf_reserve_template.finding: The IMF reserve template for Romania reports foreign-currency flows with residual-maturity buckets for central-bank reserve/liquidity positions.
imf_reserve_template.boundary: This is a central-bank foreign-currency-liquidity template, not a residual-maturity schedule for the economy's S13/bank/corporate external debt.

prohibited_inference: Do not multiply aggregate BNR currency shares by ECB sector stocks to manufacture sector currency exposures.
Do not multiply MoF one-year maturity shares by foreign-currency shares to manufacture a government FX refinancing schedule unless the joint distribution is observed.
Do not use the IMF reserve-template residual-maturity buckets as residual maturity for government, banks or NFCs.
Do not treat average time to maturity as the amount of principal due in the next quarter.
Do not assume unhedged exposure from gross foreign-currency debt.
reopen_trigger: A new official/reproducible source must provide a joint sector-compatible currency × residual-maturity/refinancing schedule, plus hedging treatment or explicit independently justified bounds. S13-only progress may support a separate government submodel but cannot close the aggregate external FX feedback.
